Pulkit Garg

📌 [...] I built AgentSDR because I was completely tired of burning cash on outbound tools that barely move the needle. 💸🔥  
  
When I took a hard look at my stack, the real magic came down to just two things:  
1️⃣ My data (who I sell to and what they say back)  
2️⃣ The core platforms (Google/Microsoft for email, LinkedIn, WhatsApp) 🌐  
  
All those middleman tools? They mostly just wrap existing APIs, slap on brutal per-seat and per-contact fees, and lock down customization behind a paywall. 🛑  
  
Worse, the stack was an absolute mess of bloat: a lead database, an enrichment tool, an email sequencer, a LinkedIn tool, a dialer, and a CRM—each with its own login, monthly bill, and duplicated copy of my leads. 😵‍💫 [...] Blasting out outreach was never the hard part. The real nightmare was tracking the chaos:  
❓ Who replied?  
❓ On which channel?  
❓ What happens next?  
  
If a prospect replies on LinkedIn, that conversation belongs right alongside their email thread—not buried in a separate dashboard you forget to check! 🤹‍♂️  
  
So, I built the open-source platform I actually wanted to use: 🚀  
  
📦 Unified Lead Database: One central source of truth for all your contacts and companies  
🔍 Smart Enrichment: Hooked into 15 data providers, plus custom AI columns for deep research  
✉️ Native Email Sequencing: Sent directly through your own Google Workspace mailboxes  
💬 Multi-Channel Outreach: LinkedIn invites/messages, WhatsApp outreach, and recorded phone calls

Marketing automation platforms [...] Extrovert also leans into commenting-first warming with contextual draft suggestions you can quickly edit to match your voice. This approach is designed to improve recognition and responsiveness before you ever send a connection request or DM, which can be safer and less spammy than heavier automation.

If you already have a preferred AI setup, Extrovert’s “bring your own agent” style integrations can fit neatly into your workflow without forcing a single built-in assistant. The trade-off is that it’s best when you want human-in-the-loop relationship work, not fully automated outbound at scale.
